GameConditionDef.label: Sea air
GameConditionDef.description: Sea air, filled with humidity and giving off sea salt, improves well-being and invigorates.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A breath of fresh mountain air. The colonists are feeling better.

GameConditionDef.label: Mountain air
GameConditionDef.letterText: A breath of fresh mountain air. The colonists are feeling better.
GameConditionDef.description: The mountain air is especially fresh, which gives you energy.

GameConditionDef.label: Parade of planets
GameConditionDef.description: The planets of your star system have lined up with a slight deviation. This is a rare event, interesting for all astronomers.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The parade of planets is complete

GameConditionDef.label: Ice storm
GameConditionDef.description: This storm carries incredible low temperatures and ice fragments. Do not leave the house!
GameConditionDef.letterText: An ice storm overtook you. This storm carries incredible low temperatures and ice fragments. Do not leave the house! You have a few hours to hide.

GameConditionDef.label: Psy storm
GameConditionDef.description: The storm has a detrimental effect on the psyche of living beings, causing fits of aggression, but it can also inspire new achievements or bestow special talents.
GameConditionDef.letterText: You are caught in a powerful psychic storm. You can hide from it as long as you are under a roof. \n\nThe storm has a detrimental effect on the psyche of living beings, causing fits of aggression, but it can also inspire new achievements or bestow special talents.
